query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `parent_child_relations` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `parent_user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `child_user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `relation_type` enum('father', 'mother', 'guardian', 'other') DEFAULT 'guardian' NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending', 'active', 'rejected', 'removed') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  `invite_code` varchar(20),
  `invite_expired_at` timestamp,
  `can_view_progress` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `can_view_errors` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `can_receive_notifications` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `parent_user_id_idx` (`parent_user_id`),
  INDEX `child_user_id_idx` (`child_user_id`),
  INDEX `invite_code_idx` (`invite_code`),
  INDEX `status_idx` (`status`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `parent_notification_configs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `relation_id` int NOT NULL,
  `enable_wechat` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `enable_sms` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `enable_email` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `enable_app` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `wechat_open_id` varchar(100),
  `phone_number` varchar(20),
  `email` varchar(320),
  `notify_on_goal_complete` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `notify_on_achievement` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `notify_on_inactive` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `notify_on_weekly_report` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `notify_on_exam_result` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `notify_on_error_increase` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `inactive_threshold_hours` int DEFAULT 48 NOT NULL,
  `quiet_hours_start` varchar(5) DEFAULT '22:00',
  `quiet_hours_end` varchar(5) DEFAULT '07:00',
  `max_daily_notifications` int DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `relation_id_idx` (`relation_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `parent_notification_records` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `relation_id` int NOT NULL,
  `notification_type` enum('goal_complete', 'achievement', 'inactive_warning', 'weekly_report', 'exam_result', 'error_increase', 'daily_summary', 'custom') NOT NULL,
  `channel` enum('wechat', 'sms', 'email', 'app') NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `related_data` json,
  `status` enum('pending', 'sent', 'delivered', 'failed', 'read') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  `error_message` text,
  `scheduled_at` timestamp,
  `sent_at` timestamp,
  `delivered_at` timestamp,
  `read_at` timestamp,
  `external_message_id` varchar(100),
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `relation_id_idx` (`relation_id`),
  INDEX `notification_type_idx` (`notification_type`),
  INDEX `status_idx` (`status`),
  INDEX `created_at_idx` (`created_at`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `learning_goals` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `goal_type` enum('daily_questions', 'daily_study_time', 'weekly_questions', 'weekly_study_time', 'mastery_target', 'error_reduction', 'custom') NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `target_value` int NOT NULL,
  `current_value` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `unit` varchar(20) DEFAULT '题' NOT NULL,
  `period_type` enum('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'custom') DEFAULT 'daily' NOT NULL,
  `period_start_date` timestamp,
  `period_end_date` timestamp,
  `status` enum('active', 'completed', 'failed', 'paused', 'cancelled') DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  `completed_at` timestamp,
  `notify_parent` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `goal_type_idx` (`goal_type`),
  INDEX `status_idx` (`status`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `learning_activity_logs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `activity_type` enum('login', 'question_practice', 'error_review', 'video_watch', 'note_create', 'exam_complete', 'goal_update', 'other') NOT NULL,
  `details` json,
  `duration_minutes` int DEFAULT 0,
  `device_type` varchar(50),
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `activity_type_idx` (`activity_type`),
  INDEX `created_at_idx` (`created_at`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `parent_weekly_reports` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `relation_id` int NOT NULL,
  `child_user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `week_start_date` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `week_end_date` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `total_study_minutes` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `total_questions_completed` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `total_correct_answers` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `average_correct_rate` decimal(5,2),
  `goals_completed` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `goals_total` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `active_days` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `subject_stats` json,
  `knowledge_point_progress` json,
  `ai_summary` text,
  `ai_suggestions` json,
  `sent_at` timestamp,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `relation_id_idx` (`relation_id`),
  INDEX `child_user_id_idx` (`child_user_id`),
  INDEX `week_start_date_idx` (`week_start_date`)
);
